lines.zh: 我拖着半截墙走路。
lines.en: I walk dragging half a wall along.

lines.zh: 石头长进我的腿里了。
lines.en: Stone has grown into my legs.

lines.zh: 每一步，身上的砖都在响。
lines.en: With every step the bricks on me rattle.

lines.zh: 未知维度的地面认得我的重量。
lines.en: The unknown dimension's ground knows my weight.

lines.zh: 我半截长在墙里，走起来会磨出声。
lines.en: Half of me is fused to the wall and grinds as I move.

lines.zh: 墙和我的肩连成一体。
lines.en: The wall and my shoulder are one piece now.

lines.zh: 走得慢，是因为我带着整段走廊。
lines.en: I move slowly because I carry a whole corridor.

lines.zh: 我的关节里塞着碎石。
lines.en: Gravel is packed into my joints.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步，先到的是声音。
lines.en: My heavy steps arrive first as sound.

lines.zh: 前面有东西挡着，我会把它带走。
lines.en: Something blocks my way; I will take it with me.

lines.zh: 我走路时，墙皮往下掉。
lines.en: As I walk, plaster flakes off me.

lines.zh: 这条路我踩过很多次了。
lines.en: I have trampled this path many times.

lines.zh: 我停下来，墙也停下来。
lines.en: When I stop, the wall stops too.

lines.zh: 我在听结构里的回声。
lines.en: I am listening to echoes inside the structure.

lines.zh: 砖缝里长出的东西在动。
lines.en: Something growing in the brick seams moves.

lines.zh: 三十七颗心，跳得很慢。
lines.en: Thirty-seven hearts, all beating very slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只需要方向。
lines.en: I need no breath, only a direction.

lines.zh: 身上的石头在互相挤压。
lines.en: The stones on my body press against each other.

lines.zh: 我在等有人走近这段墙。
lines.en: I wait for someone to come near this wall.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听见自己裂开。
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear myself cracking.

lines.zh: 我已经不算生物了吧。
lines.en: I suppose I am no longer a living thing.

lines.zh: 别碰那段墙，那是我。
lines.en: Do not touch that wall; that wall is me.

lines.zh: 你的样子，我记在石头上了。
lines.en: I have carved your shape into the stone.

lines.zh: 又小又软，还站着。
lines.en: Small and soft, and still standing.

lines.zh: 我和身后的墙，分不清了。
lines.en: You can't tell me apart from the wall behind me.

lines.zh: 你身后那段墙，是我让开的。
lines.en: That gap in the wall behind you is my doing.

lines.zh: 你在衡量我有多高吗？
lines.en: Are you measuring how tall I am?

lines.zh: 我的脸上没有表情，只有砖。
lines.en: My face holds no expression, only brick.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我闻到了热度。
lines.en: When you look at me, I smell heat.

lines.zh: 你走不走？我等着。
lines.en: Are you leaving? I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里像一堵会走的墙。
lines.en: To your eyes I am a walking wall.

lines.zh: 别这样盯着，我会记仇。
lines.en: Do not stare like that; I hold grudges.

lines.zh: 你砍掉了我的墙皮。
lines.en: You have chipped the plaster off me.

lines.zh: 这点伤，石头早习惯。
lines.en: Stone is long used to this much damage.

lines.zh: 墙皮从我身上剥落一块。
lines.en: A slab of wall peeled off my body.

lines.zh: 疼传得很慢，因为路太远。
lines.en: Pain travels slowly through me; the way is long.

lines.zh: 你打裂的裂缝，会长回来。
lines.en: The crack you made will close again.

lines.zh: 三十七颗心，不会一起停。
lines.en: Thirty-seven hearts will not stop together.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下的砖，你捡得完吗？
lines.en: Can you pick up every brick that falls from me?

lines.zh: 热的东西，最怕冷石头。
lines.en: Warm things fear cold stone the most.

lines.zh: 再多砍几下，我也站着。
lines.en: A few more cuts, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 你听见我裂开的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the sound of me splitting?

lines.zh: 食物？我早就不吃了。
lines.en: Food? I stopped eating long ago.

lines.zh: 你晃什么都不管用。
lines.en: Nothing you wave will work on me.

lines.zh: 我的心是石头做的，不馋。
lines.en: My heart is made of stone, and it does not crave.

lines.zh: 拿开，我只认得墙。
lines.en: Put it away; I only know walls.

lines.zh: 诱惑这种东西，我不需要。
lines.en: Temptation is something I have no use for.

lines.zh: 你把糖放下，我照样打你。
lines.en: Leave the candy; I will hit you either way.

lines.zh: 我追你，不为吃的。
lines.en: I chase you, and not for food.

lines.zh: 砖不会跟着气味走。
lines.en: Brick does not follow a scent.

lines.zh: 别拿金子，我不认识它。
lines.en: Do not offer gold; I do not know it.

lines.zh: 我的目标只有一个，就是你。
lines.en: I have one target, and that is you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的声音很脆。
lines.en: The sound of you hitting me was crisp.

lines.zh: 我身上是墙，你身上是软的。
lines.en: I am wall; you are the soft part.

lines.zh: 撞完你退了三步，我一步没动。
lines.en: You fell back three steps; I did not move one.

lines.zh: 我的重量，你扛不住。
lines.en: My weight is more than you can hold.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，石头会夹人。
lines.en: Do not come so close; stone can pinch.

lines.zh: 你被墙角刮到了吗？
lines.en: Did the wall's corner catch you?

lines.zh: 我身上的碎砖掉在你脚边。
lines.en: Broken brick falls from me at your feet.

lines.zh: 让路，或者变成路的一部分。
lines.en: Step aside, or become part of the road.

lines.zh: 这一下不是我故意的，是墙。
lines.en: That was not my intent; the wall did it.

lines.zh: 我撞你，是因为你挡在中间。
lines.en: I hit you because you stood in the middle.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这段走廊。
lines.en: My partner is this corridor.

lines.zh: 两个结构挨在一起，就成了家。
lines.en: Two structures lean together and become a home.

lines.zh: 我记不起有没有过另一个我。
lines.en: I cannot recall if there was ever another me.

lines.zh: 墙与墙之间，也会长出东西。
lines.en: Things grow in the space between two walls.

lines.zh: 我们并排立着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We stand side by side and neither speaks.

lines.zh: 这段墙要是塌了，我也不在。
lines.en: If this wall falls, I am gone with it.

lines.zh: 石头和石头之间，也讲缘分。
lines.en: Even stones speak of meeting by chance.

lines.zh: 我找过伴，只找到更多墙。
lines.en: I looked for company and found only more walls.

lines.zh: 成对的柱子才撑得住屋顶。
lines.en: Only paired pillars can hold up a roof.

lines.zh: 我们合在一起，比分开结实。
lines.en: Joined together, we are sturdier than apart.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡砖，捡了很久。
lines.en: I bend for a brick, and take my time.

lines.zh: 这块砖跟我合得来。
lines.en: This brick and I get along fine.

lines.zh: 我把它按进身体里，正好。
lines.en: I press it into my body; it fits.

lines.zh: 别捡我掉的东西，那是我的。
lines.en: Do not take what I shed; it is mine.

lines.zh: 捡东西时，我的手会裂。
lines.en: When I pick things up, my hands crack.

lines.zh: 这一块能补上我的肩。
lines.en: This piece can patch my shoulder.

lines.zh: 地上全是我的碎片。
lines.en: The ground is all fragments of me.

lines.zh: 我收着石头，不收藏金子。
lines.en: I collect stones, not gold.

lines.zh: 拿起来容易，放手很难。
lines.en: Picking up is easy; letting go is hard.

lines.zh: 这块石头还热着。
lines.en: This stone is still warm.

lines.zh: 有人进来了，脚步声在先。
lines.en: Someone has entered; footsteps came first.

lines.zh: 我在墙里听见你。
lines.en: I hear you through the wall.

lines.zh: 目标确认，我开始走。
lines.en: Target confirmed; I begin to walk.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块砖，是我的。
lines.en: The tile you stepped on is mine.

lines.zh: 三十七颗心同时开始跳。
lines.en: Thirty-seven hearts all start to beat.

lines.zh: 这段走廊只有一个出口，我守着。
lines.en: This corridor has one exit, and I guard it.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，在石头里很明显。
lines.en: Your heat stands out plainly among stone.

lines.zh: 我把你从墙的名单里划掉。
lines.en: I strike you off the wall's list.

lines.zh: 不用找了，我在你后面。
lines.en: No need to look; I am behind you.

lines.zh: 跑吧，走廊比你以为的长。
lines.en: Run; the corridor is longer than you think.

lines.zh: 我不喊，动手就够了。
lines.en: I do not shout; striking is enough.

lines.zh: 你是我今天的第一块砖。
lines.en: You are my first brick today.

lines.zh: 脚步越来越响，那是我的。
lines.en: The footsteps grow louder; those are mine.

lines.zh: 我选中你，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: Once I choose you, you do not escape.

lines.zh: 墙动了一下，那是我转身
lines.en: The wall moved; that was me turning.

lines.zh: 你数错了走廊的岔口
lines.en: You counted the corridor's turns wrong.

lines.zh: 我挪动时，石头在响。
lines.en: Stones grind whenever I shift.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角了，那里是我家。
lines.en: You have backed to a corner; that corner is home.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着你的膝盖。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on your knees.

lines.zh: 你转身，墙就先挡住你。
lines.en: Turn around, and the wall blocks you first.

lines.zh: 我不绕，我拆。
lines.en: I do not go around; I tear through.

lines.zh: 我和这片石头长在一起了。
lines.en: I have grown into this very stone.

lines.zh: 石头在替你倒计时。
lines.en: The stone is counting down for you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越近了。
lines.en: Your breathing is getting closer.

lines.zh: 这条路的每一块砖都听我的。
lines.en: Every brick of this road answers to me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，像一堵影壁。
lines.en: I walk glued to you, like a screen wall.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器，我看见了。
lines.en: I have seen the weapon in your hand.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，你就进墙了。
lines.en: One more step and you are inside the wall.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，不差这一刻。
lines.en: I have waited long; one moment more is nothing.

lines.zh: 你的退路正在被我填满。
lines.en: I am filling your way out, brick by brick.

lines.zh: 我把门框拆下来，握在手里
lines.en: I pull the doorframe loose and hold it.

lines.zh: 你往亮处跑，那里有我的砖
lines.en: Run toward the light; my bricks are there.

lines.zh: 你听，天花板上也有人走
lines.en: Listen, something walks on the ceiling too.

lines.zh: 我不用追，这层楼只有我
lines.en: No need to chase; this floor is only me.

lines.zh: 你把火把贴在墙上，墙是我的
lines.en: You press your torch to my wall.

lines.zh: 你的影子先撞到墙，再撞到我
lines.en: Your shadow hits the wall, then me.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着砖的重量。
lines.en: This fist carries the weight of brick.

lines.zh: 打在你身上，声音很闷。
lines.en: It lands on you with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我的手是墙的一角。
lines.en: My hand is one corner of a wall.

lines.zh: 你挡了，可石头不累。
lines.en: You blocked it, but stone does not tire.

lines.zh: 我打了三千年的架？不记得。
lines.en: Three thousand years of fighting? I do not recall.

lines.zh: 你后退的每一步，我都跟着。
lines.en: For every step you retreat, I follow.

lines.zh: 这一击把你按进地里。
lines.en: This blow presses you into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的手背上长着墙钉。
lines.en: Wall nails grow out of the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 你砍进来，刀卡在砖缝里。
lines.en: Your blade comes in and jams in my brick.

lines.zh: 我和这根柱子长在一起了。
lines.en: I've grown into this pillar.

lines.zh: 我出手不快，但收不回来。
lines.en: My swing is slow, but it does not come back.

lines.zh: 一下，两下，墙在数。
lines.en: One, two; the wall is counting.

lines.zh: 你在我身上留下的痕，很快补好。
lines.en: The marks you leave close over quickly.

lines.zh: 别急，我还会再来。
lines.en: Do not hurry; I will come again.

lines.zh: 我的拳头里还嵌着一块砖
lines.en: A brick is still set in my fist.

lines.zh: 你闪开了第一下，石头没闪
lines.en: You dodged the first; the stone did not.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你举起的盾沿上
lines.en: That one hit the rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 我抬手时，整面墙都跟着动
lines.en: When I raise my arm, the whole wall moves.

lines.zh: 你退到门边，门已经砌死
lines.en: You back to the door, but I bricked it shut.

lines.zh: 我打得很慢，因为我不累
lines.en: I strike slowly; I do not tire.

lines.zh: 这段墙忽然有了心跳。
lines.en: This wall suddenly has a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 砖一块块合起来，成了我。
lines.en: Brick by brick, they closed into me.

lines.zh: 未知维度又长出新的看守。
lines.en: The unknown dimension grows another keeper.

lines.zh: 我从结构里被推出来。
lines.en: I am pushed out of the structure.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找自己的边界。
lines.en: First I look for the edges of myself.

lines.zh: 石头开口，我走了出去。
lines.en: The stone opened, and I walked out.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头站起了我。
lines.en: At the end of the corridor, I stood up.

lines.zh: 我带着一堵墙出生。
lines.en: I was born carrying a wall.

lines.zh: 三十七颗心，一起响了一声。
lines.en: Thirty-seven hearts sounded once, together.

lines.zh: 有东西进来了，我该醒了。
lines.en: Something has entered; I should wake.

lines.zh: 我又被砌进了这条通道。
lines.en: I have been bricked into this passage again.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这段路归我。
lines.en: From today, this stretch of road is mine.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的砖，我不怕。
lines.en: Fire bakes my brick, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from height and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水灌进砖缝，让我更重。
lines.en: Water fills my seams and makes me heavier.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我拆了一半。
lines.en: The blast has taken half of me apart.

lines.zh: 箭嵌在砖里，像多了一颗钉。
lines.en: The arrow sticks like one more nail.

lines.zh: 法术在石头上滑开了。
lines.en: Magic slides right off the stone.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，只会站着。
lines.en: I do not starve; I merely stand.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，砖都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my bricks glow.

lines.zh: 空无一物的地方，我也被拆。
lines.en: Even in the void, I am being dismantled.
